profile.headline: Software Engineer & Engineering Manager | Cloud &  Distributed Systems, Microservices | Generative AI & LLM Systems | General Motors
profile.summary: Hands-on Engineering Leader and Staff Engineer with 18+ years of enterprise experience, including over a decade leading technical strategy and teams of engineers at General Motors. I bridge distributed architecture and people leadership - specializing in cloud modernizations across Azure, Kubernetes, and .NET microservices. Adept at driving cross-functional roadmaps, mentoring engineering talent, and integrating generative AI to streamline complex business workflows.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led an engineering team in modernizing enterprise finance platforms, managing sprint roadmaps and cross-functional delivery.  
• Architected and migrated mission-critical financial applications to Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes, integrating .NET microservices and Databricks.  
• Architected and implemented AI-driven automation using Databricks Genie and Glean Agent Builder, powering natural language data queries and event-driven workflows across cross-system business processes.
